Restrict factor level metadata to columns that survive an op

Source: R/execute.R
propagate_factor_levels.Rd

Implements the factor_levels half of D3: schema$factor_levels is always recomputed from the input schema's factor_levels, filtered to the names present in the node's output schema. This fixes the bug where eager select() of a factor column dropped factor_levels, causing collect() to return integer codes instead of a factor.

Usage

propagate_factor_levels(node, input_schema, surviving_names)

Arguments

node

The AST node being applied (used to translate factor_levels keys through a rename node's name map, see ast_rename(), R/ast.R – without this, a renamed factor column's levels would be silently dropped here since its key in input_schema$factor_levels is the OLD name, which no longer appears in surviving_names)

input_schema

The schema of the op's input (pre-op)

surviving_names

Character vector of column names in the new schema

Value

A named list of factor levels, or NULL if none survive
